## Purpose

`CreationHub` is a static list-style variant of the home "what would you like to build" screen
(workflow types as a divided vertical list rather than a card grid). **`imported_by` is empty —
it is not currently mounted**; `catalog/HomeLaunchGrid` is the live home screen.

## Shape

- [CreationHub.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/home/CreationHub.tsx) — a single component rendering a hardcoded `WORKFLOWS` array
  (id/type/label/subtitle/badge) as a list of buttons, gated per-item by
  `canRunPipeline`/`getUpgradeTier` from `lib/entitlements`. No data fetching — unlike
  `HomeLaunchGrid`, it has no recents strip and no server-driven workflow definitions.

## Why this shape

This looks like an earlier or alternate design for the home screen that `HomeLaunchGrid`
superseded: same entitlement-gating logic and same routing to the prototype/ppt wizards, but a
static list instead of a data-driven card grid with recents. **It remains in the tree but
unimported.**
